title: Randy Pausch Lecture: Time Management
summary: Carnegie Mellon professor Randy Pausch gives a lecture on time management at the University of Virginia in 2007. He covers practical habits such as tackling important tasks first and distinguishing important from urgent work.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a practical, memorable guide to prioritization, and some rewatch it every year.

quote.text: So much so that I rewatch it about once a year
